stopPolicy: Before each paid attempt include preparation, retries, cache usage and failed-call costs; reserve a conservative next-call bound. Stop before any next call when the remaining $2 soft budget cannot cover that bound, when approaching the limit, or when prior cost/usage cannot be accounted for. Report to parent. Do not interpret the budget as a spending target. JEV requires separate explicit allocation.
cliBudgetFlagLimitation: CLI --max-budget-usd is observed in local help only, not a verified enforcement or billing guarantee; parent must provide the approved common configuration and accounting method.
